n07b9b23c6f.headline: BUSINESS LIVE: Private equity eyes Ted Baker; JD Wetherspoon struggles
n07b9b23c6f.summary: The FTSE 100 closed up 0.3% at 7,404.7 and the FTSE 250 rose 0.9% to 21,156.62. Private equity is reported to be eyeing Ted Baker, while JD Wetherspoon is struggling.
n07b9b23c6f.why: The FTSE 100 is the benchmark index of the largest London-listed companies, and private equity bids can reshape valuations of mid-cap UK retailers.

impacts.why: The index closed 0.3% higher at 7,404.7 according to the report.

n5058535f89.headline: Vietnam, India see extensive room for trade-investment co-operation: forum
n5058535f89.summary: Participants at the second Vietnam-India business forum in Ho Chi Minh City said there is considerable room to expand trade and investment cooperation between the two countries.
n5058535f89.why: Bilateral trade and investment flows between Asian economies influence export demand and foreign direct investment in both markets.

n7550e778b7.headline: Rotation from growth to value on the cards for SA investors
n7550e778b7.summary: The S&P 500 fell more than 10% year to date and the tech-heavy Nasdaq was down nearly 17%, prompting talk of a shift from growth to value stocks.
n7550e778b7.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US companies and is the main benchmark for US equities; the Nasdaq is weighted toward technology stocks.

nc4c6472e3a.headline: Investec lifts profit forecast as it lures in more customers
nc4c6472e3a.summary: Investec raised its profit forecast, saying the revenue rebound seen in the first half continued into the second half. It cited higher lending and more customer activity.
nc4c6472e3a.why: Investec is a specialist bank and asset manager listed in London and Johannesburg, and its guidance signals the health of its lending and wealth businesses.

n0d317ca595.headline: World's central banks told not to blink at war, hold course
n0d317ca595.summary: Global central banks should focus on fighting inflation and leave governments to respond with spending to cushion economies from the impact of the war in Ukraine, the OECD said.
n0d317ca595.why: The OECD is an intergovernmental economic forum, and its policy advice signals how major economies are expected to balance inflation control and fiscal support.

n027d0890c3.headline: The Real Brokerage Inc. Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2021 Financial Results
n027d0890c3.summary: The technology-powered real estate brokerage, listed on TSXV and Nasdaq as REAX, released its financial results for the fourth quarter and full year 2021.
n027d0890c3.why: Real Brokerage is a Canadian-founded real estate brokerage whose results reflect activity in the North American housing market.

n5dafc8c203.headline: GOGORO INC. AND POEMA GLOBAL HOLDINGS CORP. ANNOUNCE FILING OF DEFINITIVE PROXY STATEMENT AND SET MARCH 31, 2022 FOR SHAREHOLDER MEETING TO VOTE ON BUSINESS COMBINATION
n5dafc8c203.summary: Gogoro and Poema Global Holdings have filed a definitive proxy statement and set March 31, 2022 as the date for shareholders to vote on their business combination.
n5dafc8c203.why: Gogoro is a Taiwan-based battery-swapping scooter company, and the deal would take it public through a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC).

na439632568.headline: World Food Programme says food supply chains 'falling apart' in Ukraine
na439632568.summary: A World Food Programme official said food supply chains in Ukraine were collapsing, with part of the infrastructure destroyed and many grocery stores and warehouses empty. The remarks were made in Geneva.
na439632568.why: Ukraine is a major grain exporter, so disruption to its food supply chains affects global wheat and food commodity markets.

n90aa43389f.headline: Altron sells document solutions unit
n90aa43389f.summary: Altron has sold Altron Document Solutions, which represented Xerox in southern Africa for decades, to Xerotech, a subsidiary of Bi-Africa Investment Holdings. Altron is focusing on core ICT solutions and services.
n90aa43389f.why: Altron is a South African information technology company. Divestments like this reflect portfolio restructuring toward core business lines.

n4aefec1dcf.headline: Nigeria: Seplat’s Exxon asset purchase brings scale, execution risk
n4aefec1dcf.summary: Seplat's purchase of assets from Exxon Mobil could transform its scale if execution risk can be managed, according to analysts. The deal is a significant acquisition for the Nigerian oil producer.
n4aefec1dcf.why: Seplat is a Nigerian independent oil and gas producer, so acquisitions of onshore assets change its production base and financing needs.

impacts.name: Exxon Mobil
impacts.why: Exxon is selling the assets to Seplat, reducing its Nigerian footprint.

n696c402867.headline: Bank of Japan says no tightening as oil stirs inflation
n696c402867.summary: Japan's central bank chief said on Friday the country will likely reach its 2% inflation target even as oil prices surge, signalling no near-term tightening.
n696c402867.why: The Bank of Japan sets monetary policy for Japan, and its stance on rates drives yen trading and Japanese government bond yields.
n696c402867.why_moved: The BOJ chief said the country will likely reach its 2% inflation target as oil prices surge, indicating no tightening is planned.

nfa286d2b56.headline: JD Wetherspoon margins squeezed by rising food and drink prices
nfa286d2b56.summary: Wetherspoon said sales in the three weeks to March 13 were 2.6% below pre-pandemic levels as customers returned after UK restrictions were lifted. Rising food and drink costs squeezed its margins.
nfa286d2b56.why: JD Wetherspoon is a large UK pub operator, so its margins and sales trends are a read-through on UK hospitality costs and consumer demand.

n2493774867.headline: Truckers protest against high fuel prices with slow march through Baix Llobregat
n2493774867.summary: About fifty truckers staged a slow march protest against high fuel prices on roads in Baix Llobregat, Barcelona region.

n61bf34076c.summary: The IMF is considering a $36 million aid package to Armenia, subject to approval by its Executive Board.
n61bf34076c.why: IMF support can bolster Armenia’s economic stability and balance of payments amid regional challenges.

nc6a4a59869.summary: The Bank of Japan kept interest rates and asset purchases unchanged, contrasting with US and UK rate hikes.

n3325c28e03.summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky discusses economic and security strategies amid ongoing conflict with Russia.
n3325c28e03.why: Ukraine's economic resilience and security policies are critical for regional stability and investor confidence in Eastern Europe.

n7170dcdc29.why: Government control over economic narratives can impact market perceptions and investor confidence in China.

n133e0001b8.summary: Pakistan increased wheat support price to Rs2,200 per 40kg, with Rs376bn allocated for procurement of 6.9 million tonnes.
n133e0001b8.why: Wheat price adjustments impact agricultural markets, inflation, and food security in Pakistan.

n3217c04ea1.headline: TN to close FY23 with Rs 6.3 lakh crore debt
n3217c04ea1.summary: Tamil Nadu's government debt is projected to reach Rs 653,348.73 crore by March 31, 2022, indicating fiscal challenges.
n3217c04ea1.why: State debt levels impact fiscal stability, borrowing costs, and economic policy options.

n979d6d9b90.summary: Vietnam has taxed companies like Google, Facebook, and Microsoft over 43 million USD annually for cross-border services between 2018-2021.
